设计意图： Combines the primary trend cycle position (payoff-first parent) with a lightweight tail risk attenuation from the predictive-first parent: when recent returns exhibit negative skew (left-tail risk accumulation), the factor is scaled down by 20% to avoid overexposure to stocks with deteriorating risk profiles, targeting improved top-quantile payoff stability.

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_skewn 期移动偏度（分布不对称度）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 high：high
  3. 计算 low：low
  4. 计算 sma200：close.滚动窗口(200, min_periods=200).mean()
  5. 计算 tr：pd.concat([high - low, (high - close.shift(1)).abs(), (low - close.shift(1)).abs(), axis=1).max(axis=1)
  6. 计算 atr20：tr.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  7. 计算 factor：(close - sma200) / atr20
  8. 计算 skew20：returns.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).skew()
  9. 计算 factor：np.where(skew20 < 0, factor * 0.8, factor)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_trend_cycle_skew_adj(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["close"] high = df_copy["high"] low = df_copy["low"] "com"># Primary: trend cycle raw (close - SMA200) / ATR20 sma200 = close.rolling(200, min_periods=200).mean() tr = pd.concat([high - low, (high - close.shift(1)).abs(), (low - close.shift(1)).abs()], axis=1).max(axis=1) atr20 = tr.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() factor = (close - sma200) / atr20.replace(0, np.nan) "com"># Lightweight modifier: negative skew attenuation returns = np.log(close / close.shift(1)) skew20 = returns.rolling(20, min_periods=20).skew() factor = np.where(skew20 < 0, factor * 0.8, factor) df_copy["factor_trend_cycle_skew_adj"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_trend_cycle_skew_adj"]
